native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: Diversity in Pottery Form collapsed (Z-score drop from 0.74 to -1.13, Δ = -1.87) while Diversity in Pottery Decoration simultaneously increased (Z-score rise from -0.48 to 0.97, Δ = +1.45) during the 17th century BCE (1700 BCE), marking a shift in ceramic cultural capital at the transition from the Late Neolithic (LN) to the Older Bronze Age (OBA).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Inverted/chronologically ordered both capital.csv and time_series_data.csv from earliest (4300 BCE) to latest (500 BCE). 2. Extracted standardized Z-scores for ZKeform (Pottery Form Diversity) and Zkeverz (Pottery Decoration Diversity). 3. Computed first-order century-to-century differences across all 100-year intervals. 4. Filtered for periods where form diversity decreased and decoration diversity increased simultaneously, isolating 1700 BCE (17th century BCE). 5. Contextualized within the archaeological sequence (LN to OBA transition).
